correctness.rationale: Stationary alternating three-state path probability ab, exact lag-one covariance ab(a-b)^2/(a+b)^2, eigenvalue recursion gives lag-h c(1-a-b)^{h-1}; summation is exact. f(lambda)=(m-1)-m lambda+lambda^m>0 on (-1,1) by f(1)=0 and strictly negative derivative. Independent Bernoulli sums with mean m mu have variance <=m mu(1-mu). Symmetry gives iid flips. A fresh path-enumeration checker passed 224 rational examples, including lambda<0; finite cases are not the universal proof.

value.rationale: A complete parametric classification for a natural dependent-event count used in runs/switching models, valid for every horizon m>=2 and every interior a,b. The strictly positive explicit gap remains valid when longer-lag correlations alternate in sign, giving an exact boundary for representing dependent switch counts by sums of independent nonidentical Bernoullis. The m=1/m=2 sharp boundary and the all-horizon formula make the result more than an isolated negative example.
